template_id.description: Library slug or private tpl_ ID.

template_version.description: Omit to use the template's default version. Jobs always pin an immutable version.

input.description: Must validate against the pinned version's input schema. Data only; never code.

max_pages.description: Reserved credits = max_pages; charged = actual pages.

retention_seconds.description: Output retention. Share links can never outlive this.

metadata.description: Echoed in the job and webhooks; never rendered.

x-td-idempotency.sameBody: replay original response with Idempotent-Replayed: true
